name: Vein Mining
description: Hold the tilde key to show the terrain material under the crosshair. While holding it, mining also clears matching ore within a 5-meter sphere around the actual hit point. Configure the material whitelist with materialIds in config.txt; the default retains the original 33 entries and adds ID 93, underwater luminous soil. Restart the game for changes to take effect. Supports a 10-meter pickaxe reach and multiplayer requests from both hosts and clients; all players should use the same configuration. Compatible with game build 1076226.
